summary: F21 is closed. The compiled stylesheet cascade finds painted body, type, descendant, and utility backgrounds. Removing layer wrappers preserves relevant rule order for the two tested pages and creates no precedence conflict there.
evidence: git rev-parse HEAD returned 941278cf354b58582e2da0f5f1b5ebf605a2a768, equal to role_base_sha and audited_head_sha.

F21 withdrawn: readBackgroundLayer now injects jsdomCss and reads window.getComputedStyle for rendered elements. contrast-fixture.test.ts:122–158 proves type and descendant selectors resolve, and proves a body-only page backdrop is #f8fafc rather than the white fallback.
The unit composition test uses the real injected stylesheet for its body and descendant rules. It calculates #fc7d7e and a 1.8112:1 ratio for rgb(118,118,118), which is below 4.5.

The two pages use layered Tailwind utilities for contrast colors: contact/page.tsx:68–75 places the eyebrow in bg-sky-50; pricing/page.tsx:58–75 places text in the bg-site-page hero. The only competing page-level fill is body bg-slate-50 in globals.css:162–164. No matching unlayered rule competes with the tested foreground or section background declarations. Unwrapping preserves the compiled source order, and no relevant precedence reversal occurs on these pages.
